notes: The booklet is a small, low-resolution picture. I could not read the exact stacking, so the structure is my best reconstruction. The piece counts and colours match the parts list exactly (39 pieces).

The body is a 2x4 reddish-brown plate with a layer of 1x2 and 1x1 bricks on it. Four tan jumper plates sit across that layer to make the row of four studs. The reddish-brown and tan 1x1 bricks were assigned by colour and count, not by reading each position.

The two legs (steps 5 and 6) are each a 2x2 tan plate with a stack of 3 bricks. The top stud of each leg clutches the underside of the body plate. They are listed as other_joins because the legs are built after the body plate.

The neck is a chain of alternating hinge plates (steps 7 and 8). Each hinge pair is recorded as a hinge join in other_joins. The two tooth plates are placed on studs of the reddish-brown hinge plates, which is a guess.

The head is a 2x2 plate on the side-finger hinge, then the sloped brick, the curved brick, a tan 1x2 plate, a reddish-brown 1x2 plate and two cones. The second inverted slope (b24) is placed on the 1x4 plate, which is also a guess.
The giraffe may well have a tail hinge at the other end of the 1x4 plate. I could not make it out in the picture, so no part is assigned to a tail.
